name: exec_command
args: {"cmd":"pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*pipeline*' -g 'src/pipeline/**' -g 'test/**' | head -100 && git status --short && node --version && node test/pipeline.test.js","max_output_tokens":20000}

name: exec_command
args: {"cmd":"cat test/pipeline.test.js src/pipeline/*.js package.json && rg -n 'pipeline|parseLine|discount' README* src test && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print","max_output_tokens":20000}

name: apply_patch
exec_command
args: {"cmd":"node test/pipeline.test.js && node --test && git diff --check && git diff -- src/pipeline","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000}
